## Facts
The client instructs dismissal without notice in May and the letter is in the bundle with full particulars included here.

## Issues
Whether dismissal without notice and hearing was lawful and what remedy lies in the circumstances.

## Law
The Employment Act requires written notice before dismissal in many cases and unfair termination has remedies available [1].

## Analysis
On the instructions, lack of notice supports the claim while cause remains to be tested on the evidence [1].

## Risks
The counterargument is summary dismissal for cause and limitation exposure must be verified promptly [1].

## Next Steps
Bundle the contract payslips notice letter and messages about the dismissal for filing and service in order [1].

## Deadlines
Verify the thirty day deadline against the current gazette promptly today without any further delay now [1].

## Authorities
Confirm notice pay unfair termination evidence limitation forum and whether the authorities are still current before filing [1].

## Urgent
Act quickly so limitation periods do not expire on the claim and evidence stays fresh [1].
